title: fynkel.TriggerZone
description: Names the event Dart hears when a collider enters or leaves this entity's **sensor** `Collider` (M3-12; `docs/scenes.md`): every physics `TriggerEnter`/`TriggerExit` the entity takes part in also produces a general-lane `ZoneEntered`/`ZoneExited` event carrying `event`, the zone entity and the other one, so gameplay subscribes by name (`world.zones.on('collect', …)`) instead of matching colliders. With `once` the component is removed right after the first entry (no exit follows; the collider stays until the entity goes). An entity without a sensor collider never fires (`fynkel validate`: `FYN-H0009`).

once.description: Fire on the first entry only, then drop the component.
